hero.intro: AI Engineer with a full-stack background and software experience since 2023. I work at Senzary, where I led the development team and built a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server used by customers in production. I build LLM applications with validated outputs and backend access controls, and evaluate coding agents at AnyoneAI on a flexible, part-time contract. Available for full-time roles alongside my current work and freelance projects.

projects.title: Featured projects

case.problem: A hackathon team needed a working demo of B2B negotiation between agents with on-chain settlement.
case.contribution: As part of the team, I built the backend and integrated the agents with validation, fallbacks and progress updates.
case.outcome: The demo took 2nd place at HackCBA/26 Fintech. It remains a prototype, not a production service.

hermes.description: Hackathon demo of agent-to-agent B2B negotiation with on-chain settlement. 2nd place, HackCBA/26 Fintech. As part of the team, I built the backend and agent integration with TypeScript, LangChain and Groq. Strict schemas, deterministic fallbacks and server-side checks constrain budget, suppliers, stock and amounts. Includes correlation-ID idempotency, audit events and SSE progress. Demo/prototype, not a production service.

prodeazo.description: Co-built football predictions platform in production, with real-time fixtures and results, predictions, points and global/league rankings. Built for the 2026 World Cup with Next.js, TypeScript and Supabase.

scoutpanel.description: Project developed for a challenge and still in progress: I plan to keep working on it until it's complete. The frontend, backend and database design is my own. Data is fictional and loaded by seed; the app is not connected to any external statistics or real player API. Features: search and filters (position, nationality, club, age), comparison of up to three players with radar and tables, injury history linked to rating, JWT auth shortlist, clubs, exportable PDF/Excel reports, heatmaps and market view. Dark UI inspired by LDP and Sofascore. Stack: Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind, HeroUI (NextUI), Zustand and Recharts; Express API, Drizzle, Zod and PostgreSQL 16; Vitest, Supertest and Playwright tests; Docker and deploy Vercel + Render + Supabase.

case.problem: Election teams needed an app for more than 20,000 poll watchers and a way to centralize vote-count reports on election night.
case.contribution: I built the poll-watcher app and helped design the wider system that consolidated the reports.
case.outcome: The system centralized more than 20,000 reports during the event, with no data loss reported.

appfiscalizacion.summary: I built the app for 20,000+ poll watchers and contributed to the system that centralized 20,000+ vote-count reports on election night.
appfiscalizacion.description: Polytics, freelance since January 2025. I built the app for 20,000+ poll watchers and helped design the system that centralized 20,000+ vote-count reports on election night, with no data loss reported during the event. I also built public sites with no downtime reported during election-day peaks. Currently developing a new app version and a CRM. Node.js, NestJS and Next.js.

queabuso.description: Two apps for the same client — Gabriel Bornoroni and Libertad Avanza Córdoba. ¡Qué Abuso! CBA: platform to report tax and bureaucratic abuses, with complaint form, evidence upload, public feed and reactions. Gabriel Bornoroni official site: campaign website with home, raffle and content sections. Full-stack: Next.js/React, TypeScript, Tailwind and Node.js + PostgreSQL.

trashcans.description: IoT dashboard for real-time monitoring of smart waste containers: fill level, temperature, alerts and collection routes. Built on the Senzary platform.

workeriq.summary: Personnel tracking and operational alerts for ENI. I built the React interface on IoTLogIQ, with real-time maps and views for field teams.
workeriq.description: Worker safety solution for ENI, built in React on top of the IoTLogIQ platform: real-time personnel tracking, geolocated maps, mustering, operational alerts and metric visualization for field teams.

case.problem: Industrial clients needed tailored monitoring and operations views on a shared IoT platform.
case.contribution: I worked across frontend and backend and supported the move from ThingsBoard to a React and Node.js stack.
case.outcome: IoTLogIQ has been used for tailored industrial monitoring solutions. Its public website is linked below.

iotlogiq.description: Smart Industry product built from scratch with tailored solutions for Shell, ENI, AES, IAC, Jacksonville Airport and Ternium, among others. I worked full-stack, on both frontend and backend, and supported the product migration from ThingsBoard to an in-house stack on React and Node.js. I also led AI tooling adoption across the development team. The platform supports client-specific monitoring and operational views for industrial and infrastructure use cases.

cloudlab.description: Platform for clinical laboratories aimed at streamlining the management of studies, results and patients.

iotarg.description: Full-stack IoT fleet management platform: real-time device/asset monitoring, geolocated maps, alarms, customizable drag-and-drop dashboards, and multi-client/multi-role access control. Integrates ThingsBoard as the IoT engine (telemetry, rules, entities) behind a NestJS backend exposing REST + WebSocket APIs, with a Next.js/React frontend. Built to scale across multiple clients with device hierarchies and granular role-based permissions. Currently running on ThingsBoard's free-tier plan, so some enterprise-only features are limited for now.

awsprep.description: Interactive study app for the AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner exam. Maps ~80 AWS services into categories and the exam's 4 domains through a zoomable mind-map, a searchable catalog, reference architecture diagrams, and a flashcard practice mode. Fully client-side, no backend. Next.js, React, TypeScript and Tailwind CSS.

mirador.summary: A platform to follow Argentine and US markets, research companies, and view investments in one place.
mirador.description: Mirador brings together market summaries, stock, CEDEAR and bond quotes, watchlists, charts, and fundamental data for comparing companies. Users can add positions manually and view their InvertirOnline holdings and balances through read-only access from their own account.

fintrack.description: Personal-use investment research assistant built with Java, Spring Boot, Spring AI, Groq and Angular 22. A validated planner gathers evidence through read-only tools from the official IOL MCP server and Finnhub. Java builds numeric tables from provider data or deterministic calculations, with sources and timestamps. I implemented the Java MCP client with OAuth/PKCE, encrypted tokens and exact-name tool allowlists, plus bounded memory and privacy controls. Regression tests cover concrete failure cases; a dedicated 30-question LLM evaluation set is planned. Code for the AI work is on frontend-and-chat.

airportiq.description: Airport operations solution built for Jacksonville Airport on top of the IoTLogIQ platform: air quality, temperature, people counting and flow, queue management and environmental monitoring. Dashboards designed for quick reading in the control room, with threshold alarms, per-terminal views and measurement history.

tictactoe.description: A personal tic-tac-toe project built with JavaScript, HTML and CSS.
